evidence_quotes.O: To my very pleasant surprise, when I received FiiO X5 DAP - I actually ended up rediscovering my headphones, all over again!!!
evidence_quotes.C: First of all, even with it's 12000 mAh capacity, this new 2nd gen Astro shrank up in size down to 110 mm x 83 mm x 26 mm
evidence_quotes.E: Before starting with my review, let me get something off my chest. Yes, this speaker is on a pricey side, and No, it's not intended for audiophiles.
evidence_quotes.A: It's clear that BlueAnt done their homework really well by studying the competition to come up with a spec, a fitment, and accessories to make everybody happy.
evidence_quotes.N: before even opening it I thought they messed up my order. I was looking at a very small and lightweight package which couldn't possibly hold a keyboard.
